season_awards_and_stats#aw7.description: MoneyPuck preseason projections and Elite Prospects or TSN consensus rankings are assumed to provide multi-season history for calibrating the coach expectation delta, and no mapping from that delta to a win probability among about 30 coaches is specified (award_vote_share_model is player-only); availability is unchecked.
season_awards_and_stats#aw7.what_would_resolve: Check whether historical preseason point projections exist for 10+ seasons and fit a coach-level conditional logit of Jack Adams winners on the delta.
season_awards_and_stats#aw7.classification_rationale: nhl.coach_expectation_delta is defined but no stage maps it to a winner probability among ~30 coaches: nhl.award_vote_share_model is specified for player awards with writer/GM electorates, so the Jack Adams path lacks a mechanism stage.
season_awards_and_stats#aw7.catalog_action: Author a Jack Adams stage in season_awards_and_stats: a coach-level conditional logit over ~30 coaches on nhl.coach_expectation_delta (with tenure flags) using the NHLBA electorate, as a coach branch of nhl.award_vote_share_model.

season_futures#sf6.description: KXNHLRECORDWORST is now the argmin of the simulated season totals (s5), but late-season tanking incentives created by draft-lottery odds (nhl.draft_lottery_odds_by_standing) are not an input here, and their effect on the bottom-of-table points is unquantified.
season_futures#sf6.what_would_resolve: Measure post-deadline points-per-game shortfall of bottom-five teams versus their rating-implied rate across past seasons.
season_futures#sf6.classification_rationale: KXNHLRECORDWORST (s5 argmin) has no input for draft-lottery tanking: nhl.draft_lottery_odds_by_standing and nhl.standings_stakes exist in the catalog but are not wired into season_futures, so the bottom-of-table effort mechanism is missing from the record.
season_futures#sf6.catalog_action: Add a post-deadline tanking stage to season_futures s5 for KXNHLRECORDWORST: wire nhl.draft_lottery_odds_by_standing and nhl.standings_stakes (elimination status) as inputs adjusting bottom-team points rates.

unreg:playoff_series_aggregate#p5.description: goalie_start_forecast in the catalog is built around regular-season rotation rules (back-to-backs, 3-in-4) that rarely apply in playoffs; a playoff-specific starter-change hazard after poor games is not defined.
unreg:playoff_series_aggregate#p5.what_would_resolve: Estimate P(starter change after a game with save percentage below a threshold) from 2005-06 onward playoff boxscores.
unreg:playoff_series_aggregate#p5.classification_rationale: nhl.goalie_start_forecast is defined around regular-season rotation (back-to-backs, 3-in-4); no input defines the playoff starter-change hazard after a poor game, which drives per-game goalie identity in s1 of this record.
unreg:playoff_series_aggregate#p5.catalog_action: Extend nhl.goalie_start_forecast with a playoff branch (starter-change hazard given previous-game save% and series state) and add it to s1 input_ids of unreg:playoff_series_aggregate and season_futures s4.
